component.name: Harmony
component.summary: Create and sync playlists across YouTube Music and Qobuz

description.p: Harmony is a desktop app for managing music playlists across YouTube Music and Qobuz. Search both services from one place, browse and edit playlists, and mirror or two-way sync a playlist from one service to the other with fuzzy track matching that surfaces ambiguous matches for review rather than guessing at them.

ul.li: Create, edit, and delete playlists on either service
Cross-service sync with a reviewable plan before anything is written
A remembered match cache and before-sync snapshots
Import and export playlists as M3U, CSV, or JSON
Discovery blending Last.fm, ListenBrainz, and native recommendations

description.p: Play-to-device now uses UPnP so the renderer's own screen can show the track (title, artist, album art) and report a duration, and the Devices page shows a live progress bar. Falls back automatically to direct control if a device has no UPnP support.
Adds right-click context menus across tracks, artists, albums, and playlists, and a "Show Similar" music action that opens a recommendations view you can play or turn into a playlist.
Adds selectable color themes (Appearance in Preferences), fixes YouTube tracks cutting off partway through when playing to a device, and makes the Devices page show the playing track reliably.
Unified search and cross-service playlist sync across YouTube Music and Qobuz, discovery, WiiM/LinkPlay device control, and play-to-device (a passive LAN relay that streams a track to a speaker).
